target.description: W0 law of docs/wsp/research/phys_bass1_w0.md, section 7: quenching and blow-off of PMMA rods, spheres, films and slabs. The probability that a flame holds is the smaller of the low-flow and high-flow targets of its geometry, taken by the scorer. Derived case inputs (SI conversions, nose radius, the heat_time default of 200 s, the concurrent indicator) are written by tools/wsp/ext/law_inputs.py. (MoleFraction is the first target with a shared quantity); targets: holds_low_flow, holds_high_flow, oxygen_limit, quench_speed, blowoff_speed, flat_holds_low_flow, flat_holds_high_flow, flat_quench_speed

features.name: x_o2
features.transform: ln: ln(x / x.x_o2.centre) / x.x_o2.scale; refused unless x.x_o2.lo <= x <= x.x_o2.hi @1

features.name: flow_speed
features.transform: ln: ln(x / x.flow_speed.centre) / x.flow_speed.scale; refused unless x.flow_speed.lo <= x <= x.flow_speed.hi @1

features.name: nose_radius
features.transform: ln: ln(x / x.nose_radius.centre) / x.nose_radius.scale; refused unless x.nose_radius.lo <= x <= x.nose_radius.hi @1

features.name: heat_time
features.transform: ln: ln(x / x.heat_time.centre) / x.heat_time.scale; refused unless x.heat_time.lo <= x <= x.heat_time.hi @1

features.name: is_concurrent
features.transform: identity: (x - x.is_concurrent.centre) / x.is_concurrent.scale; refused unless x.is_concurrent.lo <= x <= x.is_concurrent.hi @1

notes: Generic law forward law.rs, declaration configs/models/law/bass1/decl.json (status Declared): {"slug":"bass1","status":"declared","family":"other","investigation":"PSI-26 BASS and PSI-25 BASS-II (non-fabric solids): PMMA rods, spheres, spherical sections, films and slabs in a slow duct flow in the Microgravity Science Glovebox","description":"W0 law of docs/wsp/research/phys_bass1_w0.md, section 7: quenching and blow-off of PMMA rods, spheres, films and slabs. The probability that a flame holds is the smaller of the low-flow and high-flow targets of its geometry, taken by the scorer. Derived case inputs (SI conversions, nose radius, the heat_time default of 200 s, the concurrent indicator) are written by tools/wsp/ext/law_inputs.py.","features":[{"name":"x_o2","unit":"1","transform":"ln","description":"oxygen mole fraction of the gas entering the duct during the step"},{"name":"flow_speed","unit":"m/s","transform":"ln","description":"duct speed of the step"},{"name":"nose_radius","unit":"m","transform":"ln","description":"radius of the rod, sphere or spherical section as installed; 0.01 for a flat sample (weight zero in the flat targets)"},{"name":"heat_time","unit":"s","transform":"ln","description":"time from ignition of this burn to the end of the step (for quench and blow-off speeds: to the event); 200 where it is not recorded"},{"name":"is_concurrent","unit":"1","transform":"identity","description":"flat samples: 1 if the flame spreads with the flow, 0 against it; 0 for rods and spheres"}],"targets":[{"name":"holds_low_flow","kind":"binary","unit":null,"shared_quantity":null,"causes":[],"scheduled_stop":null,"description":"rod tip or sphere: flame not quenched by heat loss at the end of the step"},{"name":"holds_high_flow","kind":"binary","unit":null,"shared_quantity":null,"causes":[],"scheduled_stop":null,"description":"rod tip or sphere: stagnation flame not blown off"},{"name":"oxygen_limit","kind":"positive","unit":"1","shared_quantity":"mole_fraction","causes":[],"scheduled_stop":null,"description":"rod tip or sphere: oxygen fraction at which the flame goes out at this speed and time"},{"name":"quench_speed","kind":"positive","unit":"m/s","shared_quantity":"flow_velocity","causes":[],"scheduled_stop":null,"description":"rod tip or sphere: duct speed below which the flame goes out"},{"name":"blowoff_speed","kind":"positive","unit":"m/s","shared_quantity":"flow_velocity","causes":[],"scheduled_stop":null,"description":"rod tip or sphere: duct speed at which the stagnation flame blows off"},{"name":"flat_holds_low_flow","kind":"binary","unit":null,"shared_quantity":null,"causes":[],"scheduled_stop":null,"description":"film or slab: flame not quenched"},{"name":"flat_holds_high_flow","kind":"binary","unit":null,"shared_quantity":null,"causes":[],"scheduled_stop":null,"description":"film or slab: flame not blown off"},{"name":"flat_quench_speed","kind":"positive","unit":"m/s","shared_quantity":"flow_velocity","causes":[],"scheduled_stop":null,"description":"film or slab: duct speed below which the flame goes out"}]}. Each network is N(z) = b0 + skip . z + sum_j w2[j] relu(b1[j] + W1[j, :] . z). A positive target is a mixture of two log-normals of one median exp(N_median), ln-sds N_spread and tail_width * N_spread, weights 1 - tail_weight and tail_weight; a non-positive spread is refused. A binary target is logistic(N_logit). An event target is the competition of log-logistic clocks exp(N_c), shape c.shape, conditioned on no event before the cutoff; the earliest control stage scheduled_stop or flow_stop, and the declared stop condition plus each offset node with a positive weight, take the active mass. Lane-local targets are labelled <slug>:<target> in diagnostics.law and carry no shared quantity. Uncertainty kind: assumed_noise.
